title: Three Instagram posts for a bakery's new menu
work_needed: I run a small neighbourhood bakery and want help promoting our new seasonal menu on Instagram, using the photos and details we already have.
desired_outcome: More local families know the new menu is available and visit the shop this week.
additional_context: We already post occasionally on Instagram. Most customers are nearby families with young children. The amounts are illustrative example assumptions, not verified market rates.

brief.objective: Promote the bakery's new seasonal menu to local families on Instagram using the photos and details the bakery already has.
deliverables: Three ready-to-post square images (1080 x 1080) featuring different new menu items
One caption for each image, written in the bakery's friendly, local voice
A short note listing which image to post on which day of the two-day window
clarifying_questions: Which three menu items should be featured first?
Do you have brand colours or a logo we should match?
Is there a specific offer or opening time to mention?
acceptance_criteria: Three images are delivered at 1080 x 1080 with a caption for each
Every caption names the new menu and includes the shop's location
Images use the bakery's existing colours and logo if one is provided
assumptions: The bakery already has an Instagram account
The bakery can send photos of the three featured menu items
warnings: Two days is a short window if the menu photos still need to be taken
The number of small text changes wanted is not yet specified
The budget and deadline shown are illustrative example assumptions for this sample gig, not verified market rates.
exclusions: No paid advertising or boosted posts
No full marketing campaign or content calendar
client_responsibilities: Send photos of the three featured menu items
Confirm the shop's location and opening hours to display
Review the drafts within the two-day window
revision_expectations: One round of small wording changes per caption

title: One-page website for a small tutoring service
work_needed: We tutor school students part-time and need a simple one-page website that explains our subjects and how to get in touch.
desired_outcome: Parents can quickly understand what we offer and contact us from any device.
additional_context: We can provide all the text, our phone number, and a few photos. We do not have a logo yet. The amounts are illustrative example assumptions, not verified market rates.

brief.objective: Build a simple, mobile-friendly one-page website for a tutoring service using the text and contact details the owner supplies.
deliverables: One responsive one-page site with Intro, Subjects, About, and Contact sections
The page laid out correctly on a phone (about 360px wide) and a desktop screen
A short README explaining how to edit the text or swap a photo
clarifying_questions: Which subjects and age groups should the Subjects section list?
Should the main contact button be a phone call or a WhatsApp link?
Do you already have a domain, or should this be a single HTML file?
acceptance_criteria: The page loads with no broken layout at 360px and 1280px widths
All four sections (Intro, Subjects, About, Contact) are present
The phone number and contact method match exactly what the owner supplied
The README explains how to change the text
assumptions: The owner provides all final text and contact details
A single static page is enough; no online booking is needed
warnings: Adding online booking or payments later would be a separate, larger task
There is no logo yet, so a simple text header will be used
The budget and deadline shown are illustrative example assumptions for this sample gig, not verified market rates.
exclusions: No online booking or payment system
client_responsibilities: Provide the final text for each section
Provide the phone number and contact method to display
Provide one to three photos, or confirm text-only sections
revision_expectations: Two rounds of layout or text adjustments within the week

title: Ten product descriptions for a small handloom shop
work_needed: We sell handloom sarees and fabric in a small shop and need clear product descriptions for ten items we already stock.
desired_outcome: Customers can understand each item before visiting, without asking us basic questions.
additional_context: We can send a list of the ten items with their fabric, colour, and size. We do not have professional photos. The amounts are illustrative example assumptions, not verified market rates.

brief.objective: Write ten short product descriptions for a small handloom shop using only the item details the owner supplies.
deliverables: Ten product descriptions of about 50 to 70 words each
Each description states the fabric, colour, size, and care instructions
A single checklist noting any item information that was missing
clarifying_questions: Are there any measurements or weaves we should describe precisely?
Should the descriptions mention price, or leave it for the shop?
Are any of the ten items handmade in a way we should highlight?
acceptance_criteria: Ten descriptions are delivered, each about 50 to 70 words
Every description names the fabric, colour, and size supplied
No detail is invented; anything missing is listed in the checklist
assumptions: The shop supplies the list of ten items with their details
The descriptions are for the shop's own reference, not a specific website
warnings: The work cannot be completed until the item details are supplied
Price wording is left out unless the shop confirms it
The budget and deadline shown are illustrative example assumptions for this sample gig, not verified market rates.
exclusions: No search-engine ranking work or guarantees
client_responsibilities: Provide the list of ten items with fabric, colour, and size
Confirm whether price should appear in the descriptions
revision_expectations: One round of corrections across the ten descriptions

title: A short slide deck for a local business
work_needed: We open a new branch and need a short slide deck we can show at a community meet-up and hand to potential suppliers.
desired_outcome: People leave knowing what the new branch sells, when it is open, and how to find it.
additional_context: We can supply the branch address, opening hours, menu summary, and two photographs. Those amounts are example assumptions for a sample gig. The amounts are illustrative example assumptions, not verified market rates.

brief.objective: Lay out a short, plain slide deck that explains one new branch of a small coffee business, using only information the owner supplies.
deliverables: One eight-slide deck, delivered as an editable PPTX and a PDF, covering: title, what we sell, opening hours, location, three product highlights, contact, and closing
The two owner-supplied photographs placed on the location slide and one product-highlight slide, plus one or two lines of speaker notes on every slide
One plain checklist listing any information the owner still needs to supply
clarifying_questions: Which three products should the product-highlight slides cover?
Should prices appear on the slides, or only the opening hours?
Will the deck be shown on a projector, a laptop, or printed as a handout?
acceptance_criteria: The deck is exactly eight slides and matches the agreed slide list
Every fact on a slide matches the owner-supplied information exactly, and each slide carries one clear message readable at normal viewing distance
Both an editable PPTX and a PDF are delivered, with speaker notes on every slide
assumptions: The owner supplies the address, hours, menu summary, and photographs
One branch only; no branch comparison or growth story is included
No data, charts, or financial figures are needed
warnings: The illustrative budget is an example assumption and is not a verified market rate
Work cannot start until the owner supplies the information and photographs
exclusions: No video, animation, or custom graphics
No brand identity, logo, or colour-guide work
No market research, sales figures, or promotional campaign
No ongoing editing after the agreed revision round
client_responsibilities: Supply the branch address, opening hours, and menu summary as plain text
Supply two photographs that may be used in the deck
Confirm the three products to highlight and whether prices appear
Say how the deck will be shown, so the layout can suit it
revision_expectations: One round of wording and layout corrections
Corrections to owner-supplied information are treated as the same round
